purpose: Trial field-level schema annotations and platform documentation without changing the immutable 0.4 grammar.

hive.description: Registry hive containing the key or value. Select a canonical hive name.

x-scap-ng-scanner.known_contract: Hive is a canonical enum; do not apply a generic case-insensitive string lookup.
x-scap-ng-scanner.open_question: Which access-denied and unavailable-hive outcomes map to each collection status?

key.description: Registry key path within the selected hive. Variable references are allowed by the selector grammar.

x-scap-ng-scanner.open_question: How should inaccessible parent keys and missing keys differ in evidence?

name.description: Registry value name within the key; an empty name selects the default value.

x-scap-ng-scanner.known_contract: Value-name identity is case-insensitive; null means the key itself, not its default value.
x-scap-ng-scanner.open_question: Which native API errors should be distinguished from absence?

filepath.description: Select a file using its full path. This selector cannot be combined with traversal.

x-scap-ng-scanner.known_contract: Uses the native full_path selector; no traversal when full_path selection is used.
x-scap-ng-scanner.open_question: How should a disappearing or inaccessible file be recorded?

path.description: Directory selector used with filename for file discovery.

x-scap-ng-scanner.known_contract: Maps to native directory selection; traversal is subject to the file traversal contract.
x-scap-ng-scanner.open_question: How should local, remote, and changed mount boundaries be detected during traversal?

filename.description: Filename selector evaluated within the selected directory.

x-scap-ng-scanner.known_contract: Maps to native name selection; the selector operation determines matching.
x-scap-ng-scanner.open_question: How should directory changes during scanning affect completeness?

shell.description: Interpreter used to run the authored command; use one of the allowed shell names.

x-scap-ng-scanner.known_contract: Select the interpreter specified by the Assessment.
x-scap-ng-scanner.open_question: How should a missing interpreter or launch failure be represented?

command.description: Command text executed by the selected interpreter.

x-scap-ng-scanner.known_contract: Command execution is trust-sensitive; validation of trusted content belongs outside the command string.
x-scap-ng-scanner.open_question: How should execution timeouts, cancellation, and output limits be reported?

pattern.description: Optional regular expression used to retain matching stdout lines.

x-scap-ng-scanner.known_contract: Matches stdout lines; matching lines and captured subexpressions remain separately observable.
x-scap-ng-scanner.open_question: What exact line splitting and regex conformance vectors are required?
